handbookNote: Iowa Real Estate Broker license exam. Part of the 2026-09-03 R26 population-tier broker buildout (population order: UT > NV > IA > AR > KS > MS > ID > NE > WV > HI > NH > MT > RI > DE > SD > ND > AK > VT > WY). Exam vendor: PSI Services LLC, under contract with the Iowa Real Estate Commission (IREC). Exam mechanics confirmed directly from PSI's own official Licensing Information Bulletin (effective 2/8/2024, https://dial.iowa.gov/media/4323/download?inline). Broker candidates must already be an actively-licensed Iowa salesperson for >=24 months and complete 60 hours of Commission-approved Broker prelicense education within the 24 months prior to the exam -- a real, currently-active, non-waived separate exam. National portion: 75 items (80 points -- scenario-based items worth 0/1/2 points, so items != points). Iowa state portion: 40 items (40 points). Combined: 115 items, 120 points, 180 minutes (3 hours). Passing score is a RAW POINTS threshold, not percent-correct or a proprietary scaled score: 60/80 required on the national portion, 30/40 on the state portion, 90/120 combined -- sections are timed within one combined session but scored separately with independent passing thresholds (the bulletin: 'achieve the minimum score on each part'). track_registry models this as exam_question_count=115, exam_duration_sec=10800, pass_percent=75 (round(90/120*100)), min_correct=86 (round(115*0.75)), consistent with this site's existing practice-approximation convention for point-weighted/non-literal-percent exams (same caveat already documented for CA Notary, Utah Broker, and Oregon Principal Broker). NATIONAL PORTION (75 items, real PSI weights by %): I. Property Ownership (10%), II. Land Use Controls (5%), III. Valuation (8%), IV. Financing (9%), V. Contracts (19%, largest section), VI. Agency (13%), VII. Property Disclosures (7%), VIII. Property Management (5%, broker-only sub-content: trust/disbursement responsibility, maintenance/risk-management oversight, management contract provisions), IX. Transfer of Title (6%), X. Practice of Real Estate (12%, broker-only 'Supervisory Responsibilities' sub-section: broker's duty to supervise licensees/teams/unlicensed assistants), XI. Real Estate Calculations (6%). IOWA STATE PORTION (40 items, real PSI item counts for the Broker tier): Licensing Requirements (2), License Maintenance (4), Disciplinary Actions (4), Real Estate Education (2), Trust Accounts (4, broker-weighted), Contracts (5), Agency (4), Property Disclosure Requirements (3), Iowa Civil Rights Act of 1965 (1), Unlicensed Assistants (2), Broker Responsibilities (6, largest state section), Property Management (3). Governing law: Iowa Code Chapter 543B, Iowa Administrative Code 481-Chapter 2012 (agency disclosure, renumbered from 193E-Chapter 12 per 2023 Iowa Acts SF 514). Iowa's real designated/'appointed agent' framework (Iowa Code 543B.59) -- two affiliated licensees each exclusively representing one side within the same brokerage -- is a genuinely distinctive Iowa structural feature, documented and drafted accordingly. This bank was drafted across 20 parallel single-topic drafting passes (11 national PSI sections + 9 consolidated Iowa state-law topic groups), each instructed to draft as many genuinely distinct, real, grounded questions as its topic's real source material supports. Answers were deterministically rotated into final A/B/C/D position via scripts/tracks/rotate_broker_answers.js.
